modules.title: Strategic Planning And Analysis In Tourism
modules.summary: This Professional Certificate Course in Strategic Planning and Analysis in Tourism provides a thorough exploration of strategic concepts crucial for effective tourism management. Participants will gain insights into the levels of strategic planning, engage with stakeholder theories and analysis, and evaluate marketing campaigns, keeping abreast of the latest trends. The course delves into ethical considerations, emphasizing corporate social responsibility in tourism, business ethics, and the cultural dynamics that drive change in the industry. As a result, learners will emerge with a comprehensive skill set, ready to navigate the complexities of strategic planning and analysis in the ever-evolving landscape of the tourism sector.
